title: tinus zeylanica
intro: Tinus zeylanica, commonly known as Ceylon ironwood, is a plant species native to Sri Lanka. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tinus zeylanica include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
